name: serato-dj-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your Serato DJ library: harmonic search, crate audits, previewed crate building.
long_description:
Ask Claude about your Serato DJ 4.x library: find tracks by BPM, Camelot key and harmonic compatibility, genre or date added; browse your crates; audit the library for duplicates, missing files, tracks with no BPM or key, and tracks in no crate. With writing switched on, Claude can build new crates for you: they are staged and shown to you first, and written only when you confirm and Serato is closed, after both library databases are backed up.

Everything runs on your Mac. The server makes no network requests and sends no telemetry; reads go through a snapshot copy of the library, so a question cannot change it. Tested on macOS with Serato DJ Lite 4.0.9; Windows is untested.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: The Serato libraries this server can see, with version and locations.

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Search tracks by text, BPM, Camelot key or compatible keys, genre, rating, date added, crate and flags.

tools.name: list_crates
tools.description: The crates in the Serato Library, with track counts.

tools.name: get_crate_tracks
tools.description: The tracks of one crate, in the crate's own order.

tools.name: audit_library
tools.description: Find duplicates, missing files, tracks with no BPM or key, and tracks in no crate.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: One read-only SELECT against a snapshot copy. Only with "Allow raw SQL" on.

tools.name: stage_crate
tools.description: Stage a new crate from track ids; nothing is written yet. Only with "Allow writing crates" on.

tools.name: preview_changes
tools.description: Show every staged crate and its tracks. Only with "Allow writing crates" on.

tools.name: apply_changes
tools.description: Write the staged crates while Serato is closed, after a backup. Only with "Allow writing crates" on.

tools.name: discard_changes
tools.description: Drop staged crates without writing them. Only with "Allow writing crates" on.

library_path.title: Serato library folder
library_path.description: Optional. The folder holding master.sqlite. Leave empty to use the library in ~/Library/Application Support/Serato and on connected drives.

allow_writes.title: Allow writing crates
allow_writes.description: Adds tools that stage new crates, show them to you, and write them into Serato only when you confirm and Serato is closed. Both library databases are backed up before every write. Off by default.

allow_raw_sql.title: Allow raw SQL
allow_raw_sql.description: Adds run_sql: read-only SELECT queries against a copy of the library, returning raw rows with full file paths. Off by default.
